_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Dosimeter Calibration Certificate
summary: The Dosimeter Calibration Certificate provides proof that a passive active dosimeter has been calibrated to NIST-traceable radiation standards prior to delivery.
use_relationship:
The Dosimeter Calibration Certificate will provide proof of dosimeter calibration, traceable to appropriate National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) traceable radiation standards. Each passive active (P/A) dosimeter shall be delivered by the vendor calibrated to monitor personnel to occupational radiation from photons, beta, and neutron.

This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to contracts requiring National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) compliant calibration of passive active (P/A) dosimeters prior to delivery. All dosimeter calibrations shall be performed on the appropriate National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) phantom as described in American National Standards Institute/Health Physics Society (ANSI/HPS) N13.11 (2009); Section 3.4. Each dosimeter shall be delivered with a calibration certificate specific to the dosimeter by serial number.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete Contract Line Item (CLIN) as delineated in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Dosimeter Calibration Certificates shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Dosimeter Calibration Certificate shall contain the following content:

children.title: Calibration certificates
children.content: Calibration certificates shall meet the requirements of International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 17025 (2017) Sections 7.8.2 and 7.8.4.

children.title: Each calibration certificate
children.content: Each calibration certificate shall contain, as a minimum, the following information:

children.title: Title (e.g. "Calibration Certificate");
The name and address of the calibration laboratory;

The location of performance of the laboratory activities, including when performed at a customer facility or at sites away from the laboratory's permanent facilities, or in associated temporary or mobile facilities;
Unique identification that all its components are recognized as a portion of a complete report and a clear identification of the end;
The name and contact information of the customer;
Identification of the method used;
A description, unambiguous identification, and, when necessary, the condition of the item;
The date of receipt of the test or calibration item(s), and the date of sampling, where this is critical to the validity and application of the results;
The date(s) of performance of the laboratory activity;
The date of issue of the report;
Reference to the sampling plan and sampling method used by the laboratory or other bodies where these are relevant to the validity or application of the results;
A statement to the effect that the results relate only to the items tested, calibrated or sampled;
The results with, where appropriate, the units of measurement;
Additions to, deviations, or exclusions from the method;
Identification of the person(s) authorizing the report;
Clear identification when results are from external providers.
The measurement uncertainty of the measurement result presented in the same unit as that of the measurand or in a term relative to the measurand (e.g. percent);
The conditions (e.g. environmental) under which the calibrations were made that have an influence on the measurement results;
A statement identifying how the measurements are metrologically traceable;
The results before and after any adjustment or repair, if available;
Where relevant, a statement of conformity with requirements or specifications;
Where appropriate, opinions and interpretations
Each calibration certificate
children.content: Each calibration certificate shall be delivered as a PDF file using the serial number of the dosimeter as the file name.
